correctness.rationale: The criterion b=a^q is equivalent to L mapping into Fq and yields N(x+a)−N(a). Otherwise quotient projection K/Fq composed with L has rank one; each input affine line of its kernel maps into one target line by As²+B_t s. In odd q every line contributes one singleton and (q−1)/2 doubletons; in even q B_t cycles through Fq because trace pairing nondegenerate and trace(u*u^q)=0, so one line is bijective and q−1 others have kernel two. Hence N0=N2=q(q−1)/2,N1=q, versus norm-translation N0=q²−q,N1=1,N_{q+1}=q−1. Independently enumerated all Fq-linear 2x2 matrices for q=2,3,5,7 (16+81+625+2401=3123) and verified profiles, separate from all-q proof.
